review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib's AlgebraicGeometry directory for Frobenius, relativeFrobenius and iterateFrobenius. It has no scheme-level Frobenius concept, so the Frobenius, twist and relative-Frobenius definitions have no Mathlib counterpart to duplicate. The file builds on existing Mathlib notions: `pullback`, `pullback.lift`, `pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso`, `pullback.congrHom`, `Over.pullback`, `Functor.mapGrp` and `mapCommGrp`. The twist isomorphisms and `iterateFrobeniusTwistMap` are named specialisations of `pullback.map` and similar generic operations. Under the rubric that makes them useful API, not competing versions. The natural transformation and the group-scheme and commutative-group-scheme homomorphisms reuse Mathlib's functor machinery. I found no justified finding. I did not read the Iterate, Relative and Basic files in full, only checked their declaration names.
